design.decision: Shorten side suits early and save low [♠]s for ruffing rather than leading [♠] to draw trumps.
design.opponent: Shown on the first ruff; opponents lead [♠] to strip trumps and avoid leading suits where your team is void.
design.rationale: This is the per-event ×mult top of the Spades trump line, firing about 81% of rounds per e-trump-mult, and it is distinct from ua-trump-two-x, which is a milestone. Trumping is a defensive and tempo decision, not a snowball.
design.draftText: ×1.3 contract multiplier when your team wins a trick by trumping

critic.concerns: Per-event compounding ×mult (cut e-trump-xmult was cut at common for being hard to track); fine at rare.
